summary: Export namespace variable as namespace-object property with rewritten live accesses.

target.notes: Model observable JavaScript emitted by TypeScript first, then reuse canonical JS class/module/object semantics.

tests.name: initial
tests.input: namespace N { export let x=1 }; console.log(N.x);

tests.name: mutation
tests.input: namespace N { export let x=1; export function inc(){x++} }; N.inc(); console.log(N.x);
